purpose: Frozen-backbone AMR light-head evaluation per D0-27/D0-28

analysis_sets.primary: mixed-label clone groups excluded; paired-accession labels
analysis_sets.direct_refit: evidence-restricted refit on direct file-accession labels; frozen partitions kept

head: LayerNorm -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(960,1); BCEWithLogits; Adam
optimizer_note: torch.optim.Adam without explicit weight_decay; the pinned BacBench AMR script uses AdamW without explicit weight_decay, so this is a documented deviation, not an exact paper reproduction claim
selection: learning rate and epoch selected on validation AUROC; test scored once per seed
bootstrap: group-level resampling of near-clone groups, 1000 repeats; seed-averaged statistics use the same resampled groups across the three seeds
